task: LivenessNet training run on NUAA with and without session 03 at fixed fitting subjects, authorised by the coordinator on 5 November 2026 on the C2 card after the protocol proposal (delivery/sessionablation/PROPOSAL.md): primary comparison A* against B, B' as secondary control, no A** and no dev-mix; the three arms, the comparisons and the reading rule fixed in this configuration before the run; for every primary metric the consistency condition must hold for all three seeds, each with its own bootstrap interval; test, preprocessing, recipe and common dev as proposed; input checks first, then 36 trainings with an overall cap of 360 minutes; if the time is not enough, stop and report the run as incomplete, keeping the logs and the results available; every outcome delivered as a proposal with a short conclusion on the comparisons.
authorisation: coordinator, C2 card, comment of 5 November 2026: 'Procediamo con il confronto principale A* contro B, includendo B′ come controllo secondario. Per ora non includiamo A** né dev-mix. Prima del run, fissi nella configurazione i tre bracci, i confronti e la regola di lettura dei risultati. Per ogni metrica primaria, la condizione di coerenza deve valere per tutti e tre i seed, ciascuno con il proprio intervallo bootstrap. Mantenga test, preprocessing, ricetta e dev comune come proposto. Può predisporre il runner, eseguire i controlli sugli input e poi procedere: 36 training, con tetto complessivo di 360 minuti. Se il tempo non basta, si fermi e segnali il run incompleto, conservando log e risultati disponibili. Consegna come proposta, con tutti gli esiti e una breve conclusione sui confronti.'

manifests.origin: M2 package 20261006-M2-seed42-36c677a (accepted); the manifests are restricted; their SHA-256 and counts are those recorded in the accepted N1 and N2 configurations

cache.order: X_train = spread per class of the official training list (bona fide first) = cnn_train + cnn_es; X_test = spread of the official test list = cnn_test (M2 rule); the position of every cache frame follows this order, as in the folds run; the cache was reproduced bit for bit from the originals in N2 and again by the folds run (no new check here)

arm_b.label: B
arm_b.description: without session 03: sessions 01-02 of the S12 subjects (the fitting subjects with frames in sessions 01-02), equal to the session 01-02 part of the fitting set of the fold schema

arm_a_star.label: A*
arm_a_star.description: with session 03: sessions 01-03 of the same S12 subjects, same total as B; session 01-02 cells nested in B, session 03 cells spread over the S12 frames

arm_b_prime.label: B'
arm_b_prime.description: secondary control of the per-cell size: sessions 01-02 of S12 at the per-cell counts of A*, equal to the session 01-02 part of A* (role name of the cells run: arm_b_prime_fitting_optional)

dev.rule: common to the three arms: sessions 01-02 of the dev-fold subjects (fold k mod 4 + 1), 100 per cell, equal to the session 01-02 part of the dev of the fold schema; drives early stopping, ReduceLROnPlateau, the restored epoch and the EER threshold; no session-03 frame

nesting.rule: checked for every fold before the run: arm B = the session 01-02 rows of the schema fitting set; the session 01-02 rows of A* and all rows of B' inside B; B' = the session 01-02 rows of A*; the subjects of A* and B' inside the S12 subjects of B; the common dev = the session 01-02 rows of the schema dev (no session 03); fitting, dev and test subjects disjoint; every row equal to the official lists and its in_cache flag equal to the cache membership

excluded.arm_a_star_star: not included by the coordinator (5 November 2026): no manifest exists and none is read
excluded.dev_mix: not included by the coordinator (5 November 2026): devmix_fold<k>.csv of the cells run is never read

test.source: fold<k>_test.csv of the fold schema run 20261103-FOLDS-67b7f3d (restricted SHA256SUMS anchored): every frame of the held-out subjects, unchanged; strata 01, 02, 03 and all

architecture.name: LivenessNet
architecture.chosen: as in the folds run (create_model('LivenessNet').get_model() of the reference code, unchanged)

detector: not used: no frame is extracted (the cache and the frames extracted by the folds run are reused, verified by SHA-256 and per-frame SHA-256), so the detector resources and the frozen extractor are not inputs of this run

training.checkpoint: weights of the epoch with minimum val_loss on the dev frames (EarlyStopping restore_best_weights; set_weights when the epochs end first)
training.loss: CategoricalCrossentropy, one-hot labels (index 0 bona fide, 1 attack)
training.class_weight: balanced on the fitting set: n / (2 * n_class)
training.augmentation: RandomFlip(horizontal), RandomRotation(0.03), RandomZoom(0.12, 0.12), RandomTranslation(0.06, 0.06), RandomBrightness(0.15, value_range=(0, 1)), RandomContrast(0.2), GaussianNoise(0.02); fitting set only
training.scheduler: constant (no ReduceLROnPlateau; the initial learning rate for every epoch; the learning rate in effect is recorded in history.lr at the end of every epoch)
training.seeds: train_seed for random, numpy and TensorFlow (weight initialisation, augmentation, batch order); no split seed: the folds and the samples are deterministic

threshold.set: common dev of the fold only (dev_fold<k>.csv: sessions 01-02 of the dev-fold subjects)
threshold.criterion: eer, the M1 protocol: candidates = distinct dev scores plus nextafter(min, -inf) if >= 0; attack if score > value (tie = bona fide); minimum of |fp * n_attack - fn * n_bona_fide| on integers, ties to the highest value
threshold.frozen_before_test: written to <arm>_fold<k>_seed<s>_threshold.json from the dev scores, read back, SHA-256 recorded in every test score row; the test frames are assembled and scored only afterwards (card: test_scored_after_threshold)
threshold.dev_reuse_declared: the common dev drives early stopping, learning-rate reduction, the restored epoch and the threshold; without session 03 it calibrates both arms on the session 01-02 distribution, which can penalise A* in stratum 03 at the dev threshold (AUROC, threshold-free, is the cleaner reading)
threshold.val_loss_check: before the threshold, the dev val_loss is recomputed with the saved checkpoint (CPU, batch 16, training=False) as Keras 2.15 computes it: logits z = h @ W + b of the output layer in float64 (h = input of the output layer, W and b its weights), mean of logsumexp(z) - z[y] (softmax cross-entropy from logits, no clipping); it must equal the recorded minimum val_loss within 1e-3 absolute or 1 % relative, otherwise FAIL; the softmax of the logits must equal the scorer probabilities within 1e-4; the card records val_loss_recomputed (from the logits, compared), val_loss_recomputed_clipped (probabilities limited to [1e-7, 1 - 1e-7], informative only) and val_loss_check

metrics.decision: attack if score_attack > threshold (tie = bona fide)
metrics.per_unit: per arm, fold, seed and session stratum of the held-out subjects (01, 02, 03 and all), NA where a class is absent: n_bona_fide, n_attack, accepted attacks, rejected bona fide, APCER, BPCER, ACER at 0.5 and at the dev threshold, AUROC (threshold-free)
metrics.per_subject: the same per held-out subject and stratum, per arm (restricted per_subject.csv, column arm)
metrics.auroc: Mann-Whitney U with ties counted 0.5, score_attack as the separator, attack positive
metrics.aggregation: values of every arm, fold and seed; pooled over the four folds per arm and seed (every subject held out exactly once; the decisions at the dev threshold use the threshold of the fold of each frame); median and range over seeds of the pooled values; bootstrap over subjects per arm; no fold or seed selection
metrics.pre_commitment: reported whatever the outcome; no change of arms, recipe, threshold criterion, comparisons, reading rule or counts after any score is read

comparisons.pairing: paired on the same test frames (the held-out subjects of the fold) and the same training seeds; nominal pairing: batch order and augmentation differ with the data; b_prime_minus_b isolates the per-cell count of sessions 01-02, a_star_minus_b_prime the added session at equal per-cell count
comparisons.pooled: per comparison, seed and stratum: difference of every metric on the pooled frames of the four folds, with a paired bootstrap over the held-out subjects of the stratum (same resampling indices for the two arms); per fold and seed: the differences only

bootstrap.recipe: generator numpy.random.default_rng(0) (PCG64), restarted for every seed, comparison (or arm) and stratum; the held-out subjects of the stratum (pooled over the four folds) in ascending identifier order; at every resample integers(0, n, n) with n = the number of subjects; every metric computed on the pooled frames of the resampled subjects (through per-subject counts and pairwise Mann-Whitney counts, identical to recomputing it on the frames); the same subject indices for both arms of a comparison and for every metric; percentiles 2.5 and 97.5 with np.percentile, linear interpolation; a resample without a class does not count for the metrics that need it; no interval with fewer than 5 subjects

reading_rule.rule: for each comparison, stratum and metric, the pooled difference (minuend - subtrahend) is 'consistent' only if it has the same non-zero sign for all three seeds AND the paired bootstrap interval of every seed excludes 0 on the side of that sign; otherwise 'inconclusive' (also when a seed has no pooled value, no difference or no interval); a consistent verdict states the direction (for example 'consistent: A* higher AUROC than B'); primary: AUROC and ACER at the dev threshold in stratum 03 of a_star_minus_b; the same rule, labelled secondary, for the other strata, the other metrics and the two secondary comparisons; no statistical test; applied mechanically by the script; every verdict reported

reference_a.source: public/aggregate.json of the folds run 20261103-FOLDSRUN-e174812, anchored through its public SHA256SUMS (SHA-256 above)
reference_a.label: reference, different fitting frames and dev: indicative
reference_a.use: pooled values per seed and stratum (with their bootstrap intervals) copied unchanged into the aggregate; arm A is not rerun and not compared with a bootstrap

budget.estimate: from the proposal (scaled from the folds run, 705.8-842.7 s per training on 2,700 frames): the 24 trainings of B and A* on 1,400 fitting + 400 dev frames take 470.5-561.8 s each; with their scoring (75,684 test + 9,600 dev frames, 10.3-12.7 min) 213.8-237.4 min; the 12 trainings of B' 80.6-89.6 min; total 294.4-327.0 min, under the cap of 360 min; plus the input checks and the loading of the frames (seconds, not minutes: 4-11 s measured on the real inputs); the estimate holds on an idle machine
budget.on_cap_exceeded: status INCOMPLETE, not FAIL: the cap is checked before every training, at the end of every epoch, before every threshold and before every test scoring (elapsed time = the larger of the monotonic and the wall clock); when exceeded the model in progress is interrupted (neither saved nor evaluated: its files are removed), no other training starts, and the run goes on to the aggregate of the complete models, the final writes and status.json = INCOMPLETE with the lists of complete and missing trainings; logs and available results kept
budget.on_failure: status FAIL, exit code 1 (an error, a refused input or public file, SIGTERM or SIGHUP; Ctrl-C: exit code 130): the public folder, per_subject.csv and the files of the model in progress are removed; the five restricted files of every complete model are kept, with a restricted SHA256SUMS over them only, not aggregated; status.json lists kept_complete_models with the note 'public removed; restricted outputs of N complete models kept, not aggregated; no verdict'; with no complete model every output is removed, as in the folds run
budget.voluntary_stop: SIGUSR1 to the pid recorded in status.json while RUNNING is a voluntary stop treated as the cap: the request is recorded and the run stops at the next check (before a training, at the end of an epoch, before a threshold or a test scoring); the model in progress is discarded, the complete models are aggregated, status INCOMPLETE, exit code 2, stopped.cause = SIGUSR1
budget.final_writes_after_cap: the aggregation (bootstrap included) and the final writes run after the last model, also after the cap; run_record.json and status.json record final_writes_after_cap, true when the cap was already exceeded before the aggregation started (measured there, whatever stopped the run); they take a few seconds, measured 2-5 s at real scale (dry run at real scale with a stub trainer)

declarations.cpu_nondeterminism: the seeds fix the initialisation, the augmentation and the batch order; on the CPU parallel reductions may still give minimal differences between two runs with the same seed (N1); enable_op_determinism is not used
declarations.nominal_pairing: the same seed in two arms does not give the same batch order or augmentation (the data differ): the pairing is on the test frames and the seed label, not on the training noise
declarations.diagnostic: diagnostic, not causal: the design varies the session composition at fixed subjects and total; the per-cell count of sessions 01-02 changes too (A* 233-234, B 350) and B' separates it; arm A (folds run) is an indicative reference only
declarations.limits: the session-03 bona fide cell of S12 comes from 1-2 subjects per fold; two dev cells rest on one subject; frames of one subject and session are correlated (n counts frames); three seeds give a range; the four folds are not independent (the dev of a fold is the test of the next one); the dev without session 03 calibrates early stopping and the EER threshold on the session 01-02 distribution for every arm; the pooled strata hold 9 (sessions 01, 02) or 16 (03, all) subjects; one dataset, one attack type (print)
declarations.question: Does representing session 03 in training change the error on held-out subjects, at fixed fitting subjects, total count, test, preprocessing and recipe?

previous_attempt.outcome: FAIL at model 7 of 36 (arm_b_fold2_seed42); six models complete
previous_attempt.cause: false alarm of the val_loss check: the runner recomputed the dev val_loss with the clipped crossentropy (probabilities limited to [1e-7, 1 - 1e-7], at most -ln 1e-7 = 16.118 per frame) while Keras records it from the logits without clipping; one dev frame had a loss above -ln 1e-7 (30.98), so the two values differed (0.1936 against 0.2308) although the checkpoint was the one of minimum val_loss (reproduced outside the repository: restored weights equal to the snapshot of the best epoch, loss from the logits 0.230775)
previous_attempt.complete_models: the six complete models stay in the folder of that run and are not used
previous_attempt.results_read: the run log of that attempt printed a one-line summary (test counts, ACER, AUROC) for each of the six complete models and the val_loss history of the seventh; those lines were seen while diagnosing the failure; nothing of the design, counts, recipe, threshold criterion, comparisons or reading rule was changed afterwards: only the checkpoint check was corrected; no aggregate, no comparison and no verdict were computed
previous_attempt.relaunch: from scratch with the corrected check (val_loss from the output-layer logits, as Keras); protocol, inputs, recipe, order and cap unchanged

outputs.public: aggregate.json, aggregate.md, run_record.json, SHA256SUMS: rules, counts, metrics per arm, fold, seed and stratum, pooled values with bootstrap intervals, paired comparisons with intervals, verdicts of the reading rule, reference A, training cards (epochs, restored epoch, val_loss, seconds, dev thresholds), timings, environment, SHA-256 of the inputs, complete or incomplete status; no subject identifier, no image key
outputs.restricted: per model: card.json, threshold.json, dev_scores.csv, test_scores.csv, LivenessNet.keras; per_subject.csv (column arm), public_SHA256SUMS.sha256 (anchor of the public folder), SHA256SUMS; on FAIL after complete models only their five files per model and a SHA256SUMS over them remain (budget.on_failure)

amendment.to: constant (no ReduceLROnPlateau; the initial learning rate for every epoch; the learning rate in effect is recorded in history.lr at the end of every epoch)
amendment.authorisation: coordinator, C2 card, comment of 10 November 2026: 'Confermo il controllo proposto: stessi 36 modelli e dati, pazienza 12, massimo 12 epoche, learning rate costante a 0,001 e limite di 360 minuti. Ci serve per distinguere l'effetto della durata da quello della riduzione del learning rate; il test resta separato e non guida le scelte. Prima del run aggiorni configurazione e runner, verificando che cambi soltanto lo scheduler e che il percorso originale resti invariato. Registri il learning rate effettivo a ogni epoca. Superati questi controlli, può avviare il run senza attendere un ulteriore via libera. Conservi tutti gli esiti e verifichi l'identità delle storie prima della prima riduzione del learning rate nel riferimento. In caso di discrepanze o superamento del budget, si fermi e riporti il punto raggiunto, senza ulteriori tentativi o conclusioni sul run incompleto.'
agreed_conditions: only the scheduler changes: training.scheduler goes from ReduceLROnPlateau to the constant learning rate, so the rate stays at initial_learning_rate 0.001 (unchanged) for every epoch; the same 36 models in the same order, the same data, dev, test, folds and seeds, early_stopping_patience 12, at most 12 epochs, the checkpoint of minimum val_loss and the cap of 360 minutes, as in the parent configuration; the runner refuses, before reading any data, a configuration that differs from the parent in any other field

the original path stays unchanged: with the scheduler of the recipe the trainer builds the same callbacks as before (EarlyStopping, ReduceLROnPlateau with the same parameters, the cap check) in the same order, and the frozen recipe of the folds run is unchanged; both checked by the test suites before the run

the learning rate in effect is recorded at every epoch: in place of ReduceLROnPlateau a callback writes the learning rate of the optimizer into the logs of every epoch (history.lr), with the same expression and at the same point as ReduceLROnPlateau, which records the rate of an epoch before any reduction; the training card is refused if it lacks the rate of an epoch or if a recorded rate is not 0.001

every outcome is kept; after the run a separate script checks, for every model, that the histories are identical to the reference run 20261109-SESSABLRUN-6a50265 over the epochs trained there before the first learning-rate reduction; on a discrepancy, or if the cap is exceeded, we stop and report the point reached, with no further attempt and no conclusion on an incomplete run
the test stays separate: computed and sealed by the runner as before, reported in its own section after the train/dev outcome, never used to choose or to judge
amendment.note: control run proposed in delivery/synthesis/SYNTHESIS.md, section 5 (state on 10 November and proposed control), and agreed by the coordinator on 10 November 2026; the protocol fixed before the run is in delivery/constlr/NOTE.md; question: in the patience-12 setting, do the ten original degenerate trainings recover because training lasts 12 epochs, or does the learning-rate reduction contribute; only training.scheduler differs from the parent configuration (the patience-12 verification, run 20261109-SESSABLRUN-6a50265); every other field of the parent, its descriptive texts included, is unchanged, as the amendment mechanism requires, and where those texts describe ReduceLROnPlateau or the patience-12 verification this block prevails; no extra seed; the test is reported separately and never used to choose or to judge
amendment.time_estimate: 17,940.9 s (4.98 h) for 36 x 12 epochs with checks, scoring and aggregate: the wall time of the reference run 20261109-SESSABLRUN-6a50265 (training 16,866.2 s), same trainings and epochs, on a machine not dedicated to the run; cap 21,600 s (360 minutes), margin 3,659.1 s (about 20 % of the estimate), thinner than the +37 % by which the reference run exceeded its own estimate; run alone, as one heavy process; a run stopped by the cap gets no verdict
amendment.shared_history_check: for every model, the epochs of the reference run 20261109-SESSABLRUN-6a50265 recorded at the learning rate 0.001, that is before the first reduction (Keras records the rate of an epoch before reducing it, so the epoch at whose end the first reduction happens was trained at 0.001 and belongs to the window: epochs 1 to 3 when the first lower rate is recorded at epoch 4; all 12 epochs for the model never reduced), must have identical histories in the five fields (loss, accuracy, val_loss, val_accuracy, lr), difference 0; otherwise the largest difference is reported and the comparison is not valid; the comparison is made after the run by a separate script, not by the runner
